question.text: A man of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>60</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi></math> is running on the road and suddenly jumps into a stationary trolly car of mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>120</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi></math>. Then the trolly car starts moving with velocity <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. The velocity of the running man was _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>, when he jumps into the car.
